sources.title: Mutsuo Oka, Topology of the complements to curves and hypersurfaces, ICTP 2005
sources.locator: Section2.2, printedpp3--4 (PDFindices3--4): meridian monodromy for y^p-x^q, and the node/cusp relations; specialize p=2 to obtain the alternating relation of lengthq.

scope: The two-meridian Artin presentation is derived in the note from the pinned local braid calculation. Finite PSL2(11) quotient/mark census is new exact work; no affine Keller realization is inferred.
